info.title: Screening and Monitoring API
info.description:
RESTful API that enables your client application to screen and monitor
third parties (individuals and entities) against Dow Jones Risk &
Compliance data. Supports cases, associations, matches, and bulk operations.

license.name: A RESTful API that enables your client application to screen and monitor third parties - individuals and entities - against Dow Jones Risk & Compliance data.

get.description:
Returns paginated cases for the account.
Pagination (page[offset], page[limit]) is supported in all versions.
Filters (filter[last_match_activity_on][from|to], filter[correlated])
are supported only when Accept is v1.1+ (e.g. cases.v_1.1+json).
With Accept v1.0, filter params are ignored.

parameters.name: Accept-Encoding
parameters.description: Which encoding the user accepts for the response body. The API supports compression for response body if this header is set to "gzip" and the payload exceeds the threshold of 8MB

parameters.name: page[offset]
parameters.description: Page offset. Supported in all versions.

parameters.name: page[limit]
parameters.description: Page limit. Supported in all versions.

parameters.name: filter[last_match_activity_on][from]
parameters.description:
Optional. Returns only cases with last_match_activity_on
greater or equal to this date (ISO 8601).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

parameters.name: filter[last_match_activity_on][to]
parameters.description:
Optional. Returns only cases with last_match_activity_on
less or equal to this date (ISO 8601).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

parameters.name: filter[correlated]
parameters.description:
Optional. Filters cases by whether they are correlated
to any association (true, false, or any).
Available from v1.1 onwards; ignored when Accept is v1.0.

get.summary: Finds persons/entities matching search criteria given case ID
get.description: Returns matches (persons/entities) for a case with optional filters and pagination.

parameters.name: Accept-Encoding
parameters.description: Which encoding the user accepts for the response body. The API supports compression for response body if this header is set to "gzip" and the payload exceeds the threshold of 8MB

parameters.name: case_id
parameters.description: Id of the case.

parameters.name: page[offset]
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return. Optional; when omitted the server uses 0 (first page). Response meta.offset.first reflects the applied offset.

parameters.name: page[limit]
parameters.description: Maximum number of matches to return per page. Optional; when omitted the server uses 100. Response meta.count reflects the number of items returned.

parameters.name: associationId
parameters.description: Optional filter by association Id

parameters.name: filter[association.id]
parameters.description: Optional filter by association Id only for version 3.0 or greater

parameters.name: hasAlerts
parameters.description: Optional filter by matches with alerts only for version 1.0

parameters.name: filter[has_alerts]
parameters.description: Optional filter by matches with alerts only for version 1.1 or greater

parameters.name: filter[is_match_valid]
parameters.description: Optional filter by matches with validity only for version 1.1 or greater

parameters.name: filter[match_update_date][timestamp_from]
parameters.description: Optional filter by match update from date only for version 3.0 or greater

parameters.name: filter[match_update_date][timestamp_to]
parameters.description: Optional filter by match update to date only for version 3.0 or greater

parameters.name: filter[alert_update.date][timestamp_from]
parameters.description: Optional filter by match alert update from date only for version 3.0 or greater

parameters.name: filter[alert_update.date][timestamp_to]
parameters.description: Optional filter by match alert update to date only for version 3.0 or greater

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional sort parameter only for version 3.0 or greater. Format: +field (ascending) or -field (descending). Valid fields: percentage_match, match_update_date, match_creation_date, subscription_name. In URL query strings, use %2B for ascending (e.g. sort=%2Bpercentage_match); a literal + may be interpreted as a space.
